# ACCESSIBILITY AND USABILITY EVALUATION (Phase 8) — Lighthouse 13.6.0 + axe-core (@axe-core/playwright 4.14.0) — generated by `tools/a11y_report.py`

Both tools run on each use case's key screen **while logged in** (`tests/team/a11y/lighthouse_run.mjs`, `tests/team/e2e/a11y.spec.ts`). An issue reported by both tools is counted **once** (Lighthouse's accessibility audits are axe-core rules; the key is the rule id). Raw reports: `evidence/a11y/`.

## 1. Scores (Lighthouse, desktop, authenticated)
| Screen | Phase | Accessibility | Best practices | SEO |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1-item-details-manager | before | 78 | 100 | 75 |
| S1-item-details-manager | after | 85 | 100 | 83 |
| S2-item-details-viewer | before | 78 | 100 | 75 |
| S2-item-details-viewer | after | 85 | 100 | 83 |

## S1 Stock item details page (manager) — UC-01..UC-04, UC-06
| Rule | Impact (axe) | Found by | Element (first) | Nodes | User impact | Proposed fix | After fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aria-required-children` | critical | Lighthouse + axe | `div[aria-orientation="vertical"]` | 1 | Screen-reader users hear an inconsistent tab list: a `tablist` contains buttons/separators that are not `tab`s, so the number of tabs and navigation hints are wrong. | Keep only `role=tab` elements inside the tab list (move the separator and action buttons out of it). | still present |
| `button-name` | critical | Lighthouse + axe | `div[aria-orientation="vertical"] > .m_4081bf90.mantine-Group-root > .m_8d3f4000.mantine-Ac` | 2 | Icon-only buttons (tab-group action, notification close) are announced only as "button": users cannot tell what they do. | Add an accessible name (`aria-label`, e.g. "Close notification"). | still present |
| `image-alt` | critical | Lighthouse + axe | `.mantine-visible-from-sm` | 2 | Screen readers read the image URL/file name or skip it: the item picture has no text alternative. | Add `alt` (descriptive text, or `alt=""` for decorative images). | **fixed** |
| `color-contrast` | serious | Lighthouse + axe | `a[aria-label="breadcrumb-0-stock"] > .m_4081bf90.mantine-Group-root > p[data-size="sm"]` | 7 | Low-vision users cannot read breadcrumb links (4.32:1) and the white-on-blue quantity badge (3.55:1) — below the 4.5:1 minimum for normal text. | Use a darker foreground/background pair (≥ 4.5:1), e.g. blue shade 7 for links and badge background. | still present |
| `landmark-one-main` | moderate | Lighthouse + axe | `html` | 1 | Keyboard and screen-reader users cannot jump to the main content (no `main` landmark). | Render the routed page content inside a `<main>` element. | **fixed** |
| `page-has-heading-one` | moderate | axe only | `html` | 1 | There is no level-one heading, so the page has no top-level title for screen-reader navigation. | Render the page title (item name) as an `<h1>`. | still present |
| `region` | moderate | axe only | `#tip-ftu-nav3` | 4 | Content outside landmarks is skipped by landmark navigation. | Put page content inside landmark regions (`main`, `nav`, `header`, `footer`). | still present |
| `meta-description` | — | Lighthouse only | (page level) | 0 | Only affects search engines (Lighthouse SEO); irrelevant for a private MIS behind a login. | Add `<meta name="description">` (low priority). | still present |
| `robots-txt` | — | Lighthouse only | (page level) | 54 | Only affects crawlers (Lighthouse SEO); irrelevant for a private MIS. | Serve a valid `/robots.txt` (low priority). | still present |

Distinct issues (deduplicated across tools): **before 9**, **after 7**.

## S1 + Add Stock dialog (axe only) — UC-01, UC-04, UC-06
| Rule | Impact (axe) | Found by | Element (first) | Nodes | User impact | Proposed fix | After fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aria-allowed-attr` | critical | axe only | `#mantine-0tngl2vw2` | 2 | An ARIA attribute that is not allowed on the dialog elements is ignored or misreported by assistive technology. | Remove the unsupported `aria-*` attribute from the modal elements. | still present |
| `aria-required-children` | critical | axe only | `div[aria-orientation="vertical"]` | 1 | Screen-reader users hear an inconsistent tab list: a `tablist` contains buttons/separators that are not `tab`s, so the number of tabs and navigation hints are wrong. | Keep only `role=tab` elements inside the tab list (move the separator and action buttons out of it). | still present |
| `button-name` | critical | axe only | `.m_8d3f4000.mantine-ActionIcon-root[data-size="lg"]` | 3 | Icon-only buttons (tab-group action, notification close) are announced only as "button": users cannot tell what they do. | Add an accessible name (`aria-label`, e.g. "Close notification"). | still present |
| `image-alt` | critical | axe only | `.mantine-visible-from-sm` | 2 | Screen readers read the image URL/file name or skip it: the item picture has no text alternative. | Add `alt` (descriptive text, or `alt=""` for decorative images). | **fixed** |
| `color-contrast` | serious | axe only | `a[aria-label="breadcrumb-0-stock"] > .m_4081bf90.mantine-Group-root > p[data-size="sm"]` | 7 | Low-vision users cannot read breadcrumb links (4.32:1) and the white-on-blue quantity badge (3.55:1) — below the 4.5:1 minimum for normal text. | Use a darker foreground/background pair (≥ 4.5:1), e.g. blue shade 7 for links and badge background. | still present |
| `region` | moderate | axe only | `#tip-ftu-nav3` | 4 | Content outside landmarks is skipped by landmark navigation. | Put page content inside landmark regions (`main`, `nav`, `header`, `footer`). | still present |

Distinct issues (deduplicated across tools): **before 6**, **after 5**.
